author: sonnet
label: seeded-01-02
changes: Replaced the bare 7-box chain with a flowchart that shows every step inside the service that performs it (subgraphs), with edge labels for HTTP vs event triggers.
Added the missing branches: short stock, declined payment, late success with the stock gone, refund failure and retry, duplicate webhooks, and the 10-minute hold expiry timer.
Added a table of what each service owns and stores, which the brief required and the original omitted.
Rewrote the terse notes into explained sentences with no unexplained shorthand (for example what idempotency key and dedupe mean in this flow).
Made the cart-clearing rule explicit: only the OrderConfirmed event empties it, and it is untouched on every failure.
Listed order statuses explicitly instead of saying they are tracked.
Replaced the original's 'refunds are retried' with the rule that a refund is never dropped, including persistence and a human alert.
Flagged the one assumption (claiming a lapsed hold when stock is still free) as a design choice for the reader to confirm, instead of leaving it as 're-reserve'.
Added a short 'Terms used below' section defining reservation/hold, claim, webhook and idempotency key for readers new to the stack
Stated the communication rule (HTTP vs broker events) in the opening paragraph and clarified that the dotted line is a timer
Added Inventory to the Cart/Inventory responsibility wording (claims stock) and said Cart empties 'once the order is confirmed'
Simplified the claim decision label to 'Yes if ... or if ...' and the provider node text
Explained why a late success is possible (stock may already be released) and that frozen cart copy ignores later edits
Listed refund statuses (REFUND_PENDING, REFUNDED) alongside order statuses so no status in the diagram is undefined
Flowchart structure left unchanged
Added a two-sentence overview at the top so the whole flow is clear before the table.
Named the previously unlabeled or vague arrows in the flowchart (ReleaseStock, StockClaimed, HTTP charge request, HTTP webhook) so every arrow says how it is triggered.
Added the missing Inventory-to-Order step (StockClaimed event) before the order is confirmed.
Labelled the dotted line as starting the 10 minute timer and noted on the short-stock arrow that no payment is requested.
Shortened and smoothed the claim-check and refund-retry box text.
Reworded the Claim definition to say it is attempted on success, and tightened the duplicate-webhook note to separate it clearly from the idempotency key.
